camel_example: aliyun dbs DescribeRestoreTaskList --region cn-hangzhou --RestoreTaskId s102h7rf5anq --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --StartTimestamp 1570701361528 --BackupPlanId dbs1hvb0wwwXXXXX --EndTimestamp 1570701361528 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx
description_en: Queries restore jobs in Database Backup Service (DBS)
description_zh: 该接口用于查看DBS恢复任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbs describe-restore-task-list --backup-plan-id dbs1hvb0wwwXXXXX --restore-task-id s102h7rf5anq --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --start-timestamp 1570701361528 --end-timestamp 1570701361528 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRestoreTaskList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan.

You must specify either this parameter or `RestoreTaskId`
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID。

请填入本参数BackupPlanId或RestoreTaskId
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the restore task. You can specify multiple IDs, separated by commas. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869836.html operation to obtain the restore task ID.

You must specify either this parameter or `BackupPlanId`. Specifying both parameters returns an error
parameters.help_zh:
恢复任务ID，支持多个查询，使用半角逗号（,）分隔。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869836.html接口获取该参数。

请填入本参数RestoreTaskId或BackupPlanId，同时填入时会导致报错
parameters.name: restore_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数，取值为1~100。

默认为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为：0
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query restore tasks. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. The timestamp is a millisecond-level timestamp
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query restore tasks. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. The timestamp is a millisecond-level timestamp
parameters.name: end_timestamp

DestinationEndpointInstanceType.description_en:
The type of destination instance. Valid values:

RDS

ECS

Express: A database connected via Express Connect, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

Agent: A database connected via a backup gateway.

DDS: An ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.

Other: A database connected over the internet via an IP address and port.

dg: A self-managed database without a public IP address, connected via Database Gateway (DG)

数据库所在位置，取值：

DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
dg：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
